The research questions raised at Listening Across, a symposium on Endarkened Co-Composition in medicine, the arts and social science held on 19 October 2026. Questions sit by where the research would happen. Lines show what they share, gold diamonds mark the tensions pulling on them, and the outer orbit holds tangents worth keeping. Select anything to read its card and follow its connections.
If, when and how could Endarkened Co-Composition work in clinical research?

If, when and how could Endarkened Co-Composition work in clinical research across gynaecology, obstetrics and reproductive justice? Every card on this map answers that question from a different place.
The Commitments and Refusals columns of the original Padlet are still open. They will decide who is named, and how, in the next funding application.

Drawn from the Listening Across research-agenda Padlet, the critical position paper Padlet and the symposium transcripts (19 October 2026). Questions marked “emerged in discussion” are worded from the transcript and await their contributors’ confirmation. This is a working draft.
